seventy9 Sports Therapy is a private sports injury clinic in Guildford, Surrey, specialising in the treatment and rehabilitation of musculoskeletal injuries across the entire activity spectrum.  We pride ourselves on the delivery of a high performance service, regardless of your physical or sporting abilities.  Our skilled and experienced therapists use best evidence based practice to restore full fitness and function across the spectrum of sport, exercise and occupational related injuries, treating you as an individual and building bespoke exercise programmes to fit your lifestyle and schedule.

We are here to help educate and inform both patients and fellow health and fitness professionals about all manner of topics in the health and fitness industry, specifically in the field of sports injuries. 

Subscribe now and join us at #seventy9sportstherapy!
